answer: One number per identity: the share of staked reviews that survived spot checks. Stake 300 POA per review, get it back plus 40 if the grade holds, lose it if not. Panels void when not diverse, and each vertex is drawn from a separate pool, so a wharf of accounts reviewing each other scores zero. Every submission carries a fresh nonce and its cipher is checked before grading. Median honest share is 0.92; a farm needs 0.85 across hundreds of panels and cannot get there alone.
